meta.name: ai-seo
meta.description: When the user wants to optimize content for AI search engines, get cited by LLMs, or appear in AI-generated answers. Also use when the user mentions 'AI SEO,' 'AEO,' 'GEO,' 'LLMO,' 'answer engine optimization,' 'generative engine optimization,' 'LLM optimization,' 'AI Overviews,' 'optimize for ChatGPT,' 'optimize for Perplexity,' 'AI citations,' 'AI visibility,' 'zero-click search,' 'how do I show up in AI answers,' 'LLM mentions,' 'optimize for Claude/Gemini,' 'llms.txt,' 'OKF,' 'Open Knowledge Format,' 'knowledge bundle,' or 'agent-readable site.' Use this whenever someone wants their content to be cited or surfaced by AI assistants and AI search engines. For traditional technical and on-page SEO audits, see seo-audit. For structured data implementation, see schema.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你优化内容，让 AI 搜索引擎（如 Google AI Overviews、ChatGPT、Perplexity 等）更容易引用你的网站。它会分析你的内容结构、权威性和可提取性，并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“AI SEO”、“AEO”、“GEO”、“LLMO”、“优化 ChatGPT 引用”、“AI 可见性”等关键词，或询问如何让内容被 AI 助手引用时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查我的网站是否被 AI 搜索引擎引用。
say.note: Claude 会引导你进行 AI 可见性审计。

say.text: 如何优化我的博客文章，让它更容易被 ChatGPT 引用？
say.note: Claude 会提供结构化建议，如定义块、对比表格等。

say.text: 我的 robots.txt 是否阻止了 AI 爬虫？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you optimize content to be cited by AI search engines like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity. It analyzes content structure, authority, and extractability, then provides improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'AI SEO,' 'AEO,' 'GEO,' 'LLMO,' 'optimize for ChatGPT,' 'AI citations,' or ask how to get cited by AI assistants.

say_en.text: Check if my website is cited by AI search engines.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through an AI visibility audit.

say_en.text: How can I optimize my blog post to be cited by ChatGPT?
Does my robots.txt block AI crawlers?
